_about: The starting locations that were wrong for the period (1.65), moved to the period's towns at every start by deploy/bin/start_towns.py (run by world_fixes.py; owner's decisions 2026-10-13, research start-locations-2026-10-13). Each entry names a StartupLocation row by race and class, its spot as upstream ships it and the period's spot ([region, x, y, z, heading]), copied from the upstream row (copied_from_row, a StartupLoc_ID of upstream's 0.35 world) that already stands in the period town beside the right trainer. A row moves only while it is at upstream's spot, so the owner's own changes stay. The first nine are base-class rows, which every new character uses; the last four are final-class rows, which the bots use. Every entry says why, with its sources.

moves.name: Briton Mage
moves.why: Mythic's starting-location list (Stratics, 2001-09-13), Prima's guide (2002, p.18) and Allakhazam's start zone list (2003-02-08) start a Briton Mage at Adribard's Retreat in Avalon Marsh, where Magus Saloc trains Mages (Prima p.127); upstream has Cotswold Village. The spot is the Briton Sorcerer's (row 12), 125 from Magus Saloc.

moves.name: Dwarf Seer
moves.why: Mythic's list (Stratics, 2001-09-13), Prima (2002), Allakhazam (2003-02-08) and Prima's Atlas (2002: "Dwarf Seers start in Vasudheim"); upstream has Haggerfel. The spot is the Dwarf Healer's (row 114), 140 from Tosti, the Seer trainer.

moves.name: Kobold Seer
moves.why: Mythic's list (Stratics, 2001-09-13) and Prima's Atlas (2002) start a Kobold Seer in the Vale of Mularn, and Allakhazam (2003-02-08, and its 2004-02-27 update) names Haggerfel, where the Vale's only Seer trainer, Groa, stands; upstream has Fort Atla. The spot is the Kobold Shaman's (row 100), 93 from Groa.

moves.name: Norseman Seer
moves.why: Mythic's list (Stratics, 2001-09-13) and Prima's Atlas (2002: "Norseman Seer ... starting place is Fort Atla in Gotar"); Allakhazam's 2004-02-27 update says Galplen, and the owner chose the earlier sources (2026-10-13). Upstream has Vasudheim. The spot is the Kobold Seer's as upstream ships it (row 506), 101 from Hyndia, the Seer trainer: the three Seers form a cycle, so the file holds both spots and no other row is read.

moves.name: Elf Stalker
moves.why: Mythic's list (Stratics, 2001-09-13), Prima (2002) and Allakhazam (2003-02-08); upstream has Howth. The spot is the Elf Nightshade's (row 70), 115 from Ula, the Stalker trainer.

moves.name: Briton Disciple
moves.why: The Shrouded Isles base classes started only in their SI city: Allakhazam's 2004-02-27 update ("(only)"), and Mythic's 1.72 patch notes (2004-10-26): "All newly created Shrouded Isles races and base classes now have the option of starting in either a classic Camelot location ... or their Shrouded Isles location", so before 1.72 they had none (owner 2026-10-13: as before 1.72). Upstream has Cotswold Village. The spot is the Briton Necromancer's (row 14), 132 from Narah, the Disciple trainer.

moves.name: Troll Mystic
moves.why: A Troll Mystic can only become a Bonedancer, a Shrouded Isles class: Allakhazam's 2004-02-27 update, "Mystic (Bonedancer) in Aegirhamn ... (only)" (Mythic's 1.72 patch notes, 2004-10-26, opened classic towns to the Shrouded Isles races and base classes later; owner 2026-10-13: as before 1.72). Upstream has Fort Atla. The spot is the Troll Bonedancer's (row 122), 160 from Pedra, the Mystic trainer.

moves.name: Celt Forester
moves.why: The Shrouded Isles base classes started only in their SI city: Allakhazam's 2004-02-27 update ("Way of the Grove ... (only)"), and Mythic's 1.72 patch notes (2004-10-26), which gave them a classic start only then (owner 2026-10-13: as before 1.72). Upstream has Howth. The spot is the Celt Valewalker's (row 53), 129 from Miach, the Forester trainer.

moves.name: Firbolg Forester
moves.why: As the Celt Forester: Allakhazam's 2004-02-27 update and Mythic's 1.72 patch notes (2004-10-26; owner 2026-10-13: as before 1.72). Upstream has a spot just outside Ardee. The spot is the Firbolg Valewalker's (row 68), the Celt Valewalker's too, 129 from Miach.

moves.name: Highlander Scout
moves.why: A Scout is a Rogue, and Mythic's list (Stratics, 2001-09-13), Prima (2002; p.130: Master Odon, Rogue trainer, Ludlow) and Allakhazam (2003-02-08) start a Highlander Rogue at Ludlow Village, as upstream's base-class row does; its final-class Scout row, which bots stored as Highlander Scouts start from, has Humberton Village. The spot is the Highlander Minstrel's (row 115), 99 from Master Odon.

moves.name: Elf Blademaster
moves.why: A Blademaster is a Guardian, and Mythic's list (Stratics, 2001-09-13), Prima (2002) and Allakhazam (2003-02-08) start an Elf Guardian at Howth, as upstream's base-class row does; its final-class Blademaster row, which bots stored as Elf Blademasters start from, has Mag Mell. The spot is the Elf Guardian's (row 548), 113 from Kaley, the Guardian trainer.

moves.name: Elf Champion
moves.why: A Champion is a Guardian: as the Elf Blademaster (Mythic's list, Stratics, 2001-09-13; Prima, 2002; Allakhazam, 2003-02-08). Upstream's final-class Champion row has Mag Mell. The spot is the Elf Guardian's (row 548), 113 from Kaley.

moves.name: Norseman Healer
moves.why: A Healer is a Seer, and the Norseman Seer starts at Fort Atla (Mythic's list, Stratics, 2001-09-13; Prima's Atlas, 2002; owner 2026-10-13). Upstream's final-class Healer row, which bots stored as Norseman Healers start from, has Galplen, as Allakhazam's 2004-02-27 update. The spot is the Norseman Seer's: the Kobold Seer's as upstream ships it (row 506), 101 from Hyndia.
